metadata.title: A decomposition theorem for elliptic structures of minimal rank on compact Lie groups and applications
metadata.abstract: We show that every left-invariant elliptic structure of minimal rank on an odd-dimensional compact Lie group admits an algebraic decomposition analogous to those obtained by Pittie in the complex case and by Charbonnel and Khalgui for left-invariant CR structures of hypersurface type. We then use this decomposition to prove that the cohomology associated with such an elliptic structure can be reduced to a computation on a suitable maximal torus.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: 代数分解与上同调约化
analysis.workSummary: 对奇维紧 Lie 群上的最小秩左不变椭圆结构建立代数分解，并把其相关上同调化为适当极大环面上的计算。
analysis.breakthrough: 推广复结构及超曲面型 CR 结构的分解思路。
analysis.limitations: 必须满足左不变及最小秩条件。 当前为摘要级数学解读；AI 披露另行做独立全文核查，尚未核验的记录不代表未使用 AI。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。

analysis.priorityReason: 对 Lie 群复几何和上同调计算具有工具价值。
